PUBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
MINUTES

A meeting of the Public Services Committee was held on Tuesday, September 19, 2023, in
Committee Room 104 and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance
were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Bryan Cook, Chairman, Pete Laybourn, Dr. Rinne, and Tom
Segrave.

AGENDA ITEMS

12. ORDINANCE ~3" READING ~ Amending Section 15.08.031, Building Permit Fees-
Exceptions for Incentivization Program, of Chapter 15.08, International Building Code
Adopted, of Title 15, Buildings and Construction, of the Code of the City of Cheyenne,
Wyoming, to create incentives for attainable housing and historic preservation.

Dr. Rinne moved to approve on 3" and final reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried
with Dr. Rinne and Mr. Segrave voting “YES” and Mr. Laybourn voting “NO”.

Lonnie Olson, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and committee
member Laybourn commented on the item.

13. ORDINANCE -2 READING ~ Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from MUB Mixed-Use Business Emphasis to
P Public District for land located at Lot 1, Block 1, Back 40 Subdivision, Third Filing.
(SPONSOR — MR. COOK)

Dr. Rinne moved to approve on 2™ reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report. Committee members
Rinne and Segrave commented on the item and public comment was made by Michael White.

14. ORDINANCE -2" READING — Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from CB Community Business to MUB
Mixed-Use Business for land located on Lots 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8, Block I, Hitching Post
Plaza, 3" Filing. (SPONSOR ~ MR. COOK)

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2" reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn, Mr. Segrave moved to
amend by substitute dated September 14, 2023, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion to amend carried
by unanimous voice vote. Main motion, as amended, carried by unanimous voice vote
